freePlan.limits: Wix-branded subdomain (mysite.wixsite.com), no custom domain, Wix ads/branding, basic storage

keyLimits.en: 2 GB storage, free custom domain (1 year), 2 site collaborators
50 GB storage, free custom domain (1 year), 5 site collaborators, ecommerce features
100 GB storage, free custom domain (1 year), 10 site collaborators
Unlimited storage, free custom domain (1 year), 100 site collaborators

cautions.en: Monthly prices shown on the pricing page are already discounted list prices; an annual commitment is required to lock them in and the source page did not show a separate month-to-month rate.
The free plan does not allow a custom domain; a paid plan is required to remove Wix branding and use your own domain.

capabilities.en: Drag-and-drop visual editor plus an AI website builder that generates a site from a text prompt.
Built-in ecommerce (product sales, subscriptions, memberships) and payment processing via Wix Payments.
Appointment scheduling, lead management/CRM, email marketing, and SEO tools included natively.
2000+ industry templates and a library of free graphics/animations.

limitations.en: Free plan keeps a Wix-branded subdomain (mysite.wixsite.com); a custom domain requires a paid plan.
Switching templates after publishing a site is limited compared to code-based site builders; deep customization beyond the visual editor is constrained.

reason.en: Main competitor for building a full website with more code-level flexibility.
Hosted, no-code website builder aimed at a similar non-technical audience.
Alternative when the priority is ecommerce on a self-hosted stack rather than an all-in-one hosted builder.
No-code builder alternative for more app-like, logic-driven sites.

unknowns: Exact annual (yearly-billed) per-month prices were not clearly separated from the monthly rate on the fetched pricing page; the page showed one set of prices with a general '50% savings' banner rather than two clean monthly/annual columns.
Whether displayed USD prices include tax was not stated on the pricing page.
Free plan exact storage/bandwidth caps were not itemized on the fetched page.
